turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Namaste ji, main aapki madad ke liye call kiya hu, koi dikkat toh nahi hai na?

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Ji haan, mera card block ho chuka hai aur mujhe netbanking ka issue lag raha hai, shayad netbanking Click se related kuch hua hoga.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Chinta mat kijiye, hum check karte hain - pehle cheque Click dekhenge, aur agar zarurat padi toh statement Click bhi verify karenge.

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Arre waah, yeh toh bohot helpful lagega, kyunki meri Aadhaar Prime se linked details bhi check ho jaengi aur mujhe ZepNidhi, TavBima jaise options bhi samajh aa rahe hain.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Bilkul ji, hum NEFT Click enable kar denge, saath hi VeloVetan aur ZepSugam activate karke aapko card unblock karwa denge.
